Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: Market data redistributors should process this message to populate the Financial Status Indicator (required display field) and the Market Category (recommended display field) for NASDAQ-listed issues.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate Code uniquely assigned to the security symbol for the day.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the directory message was generated. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For NASDAQ-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if NASDAQ system limits order entry for issue

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in NASDAQ systems in a live/production, test, or demo state. Please note that firms should only show live issues and quoting participants on public quotation displays.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the NASDAQ security is set up for IPO release. This field is intended to help NASDAQ market participant firms comply with FINRA Rule 5131(b).

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP):

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index. Example: If the underlying Index increases by a value of 1 and the ETP’s Leverage factor is 3, indicates the ETF will increase/decrease (see Inverse) by 3. Note: Leverage Factor of 1 indicates the ETP is NOT leveraged. This field is used for LULD Tier I price band calculation purposes.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index. Example: An ETP Leverage Factor of 3 and an Inverse value of ‘Y’ indicates the ETP will decrease by a value of 3.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part. It is possible to receive several Order Executed Messages for the same order reference number if that order is executed in several parts. The multiple Order Executed Messages on the same order are cumulative.

Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The order reference number associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Order Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price. Since the execution price is different than the display price of the original Add Order, NASDAQ includes a price field within this execution message.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp

Field.Description: The reference number of the order that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Shares

Field.Name: Match Number

Field.Name: Printable

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The price at which the order execution occurred. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is being cancelled. All remaining shares are no longer accessible so the order must be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ OMX internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being canceled.

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book has been cancel-replaced. All remaining shares from the original order are no longer accessible, and must be removed. The new order details are provided for the replacement, along with a new order reference number which will be used henceforth. Since the side, stock symbol and attribution (if any) cannot be changed by an Order Replace event, these fields are not included in the message. Firms should retain the side, stock symbol and MPID from the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Stock Locate
Field.Description: Locate code identifying the security

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The original reference number of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The new reference number for this order at time of replacement. Please note that the NASDAQ system will use this new order reference number for all subsequent updates.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The new total displayed quantity.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new display price for the order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

(Note: For the halted / paused securities, firms should use the Trading Action message to determine when an issue has been released for trading.)
